propositions: The hourly host updater bypasses the committed uv lock and Click security override by using unlocked pipx VCS installation instead of exact-SHA checkout with uv sync --locked
The updater must check out the exact git SHA returned by git ls-remote and run uv sync --locked inside that checkout to preserve lock and security constraints
Failed sync or smoke-test operations must log rejection, exit nonzero, and leave the current release byte-identical to ensure safe failure mode

Atomic publication must retain only the published release and remove rejected candidates, with symlinks (rebar, rebar-mcp, last-good.sha) resolving through current into the versioned exact-SHA directory
The published runtime must report Click 8.4.2 with no PYSEC-2026-2132 vulnerability and pass CLI help commands
Launchd-triggered installation must complete deterministically, with immediate re-run detecting no change and logging the currently-installed SHA
